input: Join a local urban sketching group this month

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: "Joining" could mean simply signing up online, attending one session, or becoming a recurring participant — the effort and steps differ significantly.
The user's city or neighbourhood determines which specific groups exist and how accessible they are.
Knowing the user's current skill level affects whether they need a beginner-friendly group or are comfortable with any level.
Availability on specific days/times narrows down which group meetups are actually feasible to attend.
Whether the user wants in-person meetups only, online/hybrid options, or both changes where to search and what counts as a local group.
Some groups are casual social meetups; others are more structured or critique-focused — the user's preferred vibe shapes which group is the right fit.
The user's definition of success (e.g., made connections, attended X sessions, feels like a regular member) determines when the task is truly done.

gold.taskTitle: Join a local urban sketching group this month
gold.taskDescription: Find and become an active member of a local urban sketching group within the current month.

questions.title: What does "joining" mean to you — signing up, or attending a session?
questions.description: Clarify whether the goal is met by registering/finding a group online, physically attending at least one meetup, or committing to regular attendance.

questions.title: Which city or neighbourhood are you based in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to narrow down which local urban sketching groups, chapters, or clubs actually exist nearby.

questions.title: How would you describe your current sketching experience level?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is a complete beginner, casual hobbyist, or experienced sketcher, so the right type of group can be targeted.

questions.title: Which days or times are you free to attend meetups?
questions.description: Understand the user's weekly schedule to filter groups whose session times are realistically compatible.

questions.title: Do you want in-person meetups, or would online sessions count?
questions.description: Establish whether the user is open to virtual or hybrid groups, which significantly broadens or narrows the search.

questions.title: Do you prefer a casual social vibe or a more structured, critique-focused group?
questions.description: Identify the user's preferred group atmosphere to match them with a group whose format and culture suits their personality and goals.

questions.title: What would make you feel you have truly succeeded at this task?
questions.description: Define the user's personal finish line — e.g., made a new friend, completed a sketch in public, attended two sessions — to set a clear target.
